pivotal_result: STRIVE, a randomised trial in 955 patients with episodic migraine: by months 4 through 6, mean migraine days per month were reduced by 3.2 days in the 70-mg erenumab group and 3.7 days in the 140-mg group, compared with 1.8 days in the placebo group (P less than 0.001 for each dose versus placebo); a 50% or greater reduction in mean migraine days per month was achieved by 43.3% of patients on 70 mg and 50.0% on 140 mg, compared with 26.6% on placebo. Trial registration NCT02456740; paper DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa1705848.
